independent_acquisition.open.title: Futures Independent Club Signing Window Opens
independent_acquisition.open.news.body:
KBO opened the player acquisition window for independent clubs playing in the Futures League. The window remains open until the end of the KBO regular season, giving independent clubs a chance to cover roster gaps while giving standout players another path back into the league picture.

During this period, independent Futures clubs such as the Ulsan Whales can make roster additions through a separate process before the regular season ends. Actual acquisition eligibility still depends on each player's contract status and league registration rules.
independent_acquisition.transfer.title: {seller_team_name}'s {player_name} moves to {buyer_team_name} for ${cash_cost}
independent_acquisition.transfer.news.bo:
{player_link} moved from Futures independent club {seller_team_link} to {buyer_team_link} for a ${cash_cost} transfer fee.

The move was completed through the independent-club acquisition window, with {buyer_team_link} paying {seller_team_link} to add depth during the season.
